name: hdie_pc_ctrl-hdie-COMMIT
purpose: HBM v15 die: per-PC REAL memory controller leaf (owner 10-14 all on-chip execution real): actual ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc sequencer + same-row FIFO32 + 32 reserved responses in a real 128x256 SRAM; the stack g_pc body verbatim. 128 instances (32/stack) in the PC band boxes between the PHY-only abstract ot_hbm3e_phy_rc_e8p5 (S face) and the SM service groups (N face, K port). Flow control k_rdy/kr_rdy is the HBM-stack boundary (owner 10-14). Clock: the HBM controller clock hbm (CK/2 = 1.024 ns, the r14 timing basis; asynchronous to stream via the group FIFOs), so the kit period is 1024 ps. OREG=1: every PHY-side command output from a flop.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf #(.P(0), .PHASE(0), .OREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/loader/service_native/ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf.sv rtl/model_ready_hbm_r14/ot_hbm_r14_stream_pc.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hdie_pc_ctrl/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hdie_pc_ctrl/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hdie_pc_ctrl --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hbm_svc_pc_ctrl_leaf --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
